The '''''Takara''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[700 BBY]].<ref name="HOD" />

==Characteristics==
The ship was large enough to risk flying through the turbulent storms of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]
and could carry several starfighters. The vessel's bridge had large, green display screens.<ref name="HOD" />

==History==
It carried several Jedi, as well as their fighters, during a purge of a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] cult in the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]]. The ''Takara'' spent some time reaching the starfighters' position in orbit of Dagobah, before landing on the planet to pick up the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]], who had just defeated the leader of the [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] Dark Jedi cult.<ref name="HOD" />
